verdict.rationale: A community hands-on report says the iOS SDK automatically reports fatal errors. The docs mention 50+ platform libraries, events correlated by device, and filtering by release, which together imply some device and app-version context. No evidence explicitly covers Android or NDK native crash capture, or the OS and device metadata attached to crash reports. Missing for 10: documented Android crash capture, documented NDK/native C/C++ crash capture, explicit device/OS/app-version metadata on crash events, first-party iOS crash docs.
